explanation: The actual values drop to a new, lower level around 2024-02, while the forecast remains at the previous higher level. This is a structural break that the LightGBM model is failing to adapt to. Evidence: Actuals show a sharp drop from ~90 to ~30-40; Forecast stays in the 60-100 range; Sign of error is persistently positive (under-prediction) for a long period after the drop.
